description: Implementation of a caching certificate verifier class for network security, including cache management, verification logic, and observer pattern handling.

classes.name: CachingCertVerifier
classes.description: A class that caches certificate verification results to improve performance and reduce redundant verifications.

classes.name: CachingCertVerifier::CachedResult
classes.description: Structure to hold cached verification results.

classes.name: CachingCertVerifier::CacheValidityPeriod
classes.description: Defines the validity period for cache entries based on verification time.

classes.name: CachingCertVerifier::CacheExpirationFunctor
classes.description: Functor to determine if a cache entry has expired based on time.

methods.name: CachingCertVerifier::Verify
methods.description: Performs certificate verification, utilizing cache if available.

methods.name: CachingCertVerifier::SetConfig
methods.description: Sets the verification configuration and clears cache.

methods.name: CachingCertVerifier::AddObserver
methods.description: Adds an observer to the verifier.

methods.name: CachingCertVerifier::RemoveObserver
methods.description: Removes an observer from the verifier.

methods.name: CachingCertVerifier::OnRequestFinished
methods.description: Handles completion of verification requests, updating cache.

methods.name: CachingCertVerifier::AddResultToCache
methods.description: Adds verification result to cache with validity period.

methods.name: CachingCertVerifier::GetCacheSize
methods.description: Returns current size of the cache.
